reason: The pallet is buried, so I want to use the winch to pull it free.
expectation: The winch may lift or uncover the pallet, though it might need an attachment first.

alternatives.reason: Opening the shipping frame could help, but freeing the buried pallet seems more urgent.

effect: The array is free and now needs to power the cabin.
reaction: The winch worked as expected; the new goal makes the next job clear.
reason: The service tool and shipping frame are the only offered combination, and may release equipment for the connection.
expectation: I expect to open or dismantle the frame and find a useful component, but I am guessing.

effect: The shipping frame yields reusable aluminium, suggesting I can fabricate a part.
reaction: I like repurposing the shipping braces, though their connection to powering the cabin is still unclear.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and the stock can apparently be worked with the tool.
expectation: I expect to make a component from the aluminium, perhaps an array support.

effect: The cut stock can provide mounting feet for the array and material for later work.
reaction: The description makes the reuse feel purposeful and gives a concrete picture of the parts.
reason: The array needs its mounting feet, and this is the offered combination.
expectation: The feet will be attached to stabilize the array.

effect: The array now stands, ready for a power connection.
reaction: Satisfying to see the recovered parts become a working setup, though it happened quickly.
reason: The power lead naturally connects the standing array to the cabin.
expectation: The lead will connect the array and supply power to the cabin.

effect: The connected array powers the cabin and completes the goal.
reaction: The fan changing note gives a satisfying sensory payoff to the assembly.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the array and hearing the cabin fan settle made the practical result tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the stock felt like a necessary intermediate action rather than an interesting decision, since it was the only combination offered.

surprise.text: I didn't initially expect the shipping frame to become mounting feet for the array.

arbitrary.text: Opening the frame was initially unclear as a route to powering the cabin, although the later mounting feet explained it.

continue.text: Yes, cautiously: the reuse of materials and concrete payoff make me curious what I might build next, although most of this chapter offered only one action at a time.
